items.title: 18.4 Predicting Formula and Charge of a Complex Ion (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 18.4 with Table 18.3, printed page 21.

blocks.text: Complex ion ka formula aur charge markazi metal ion, us ki oxidation state, aur ligands aur un ke charges ko mila kar maloom kiya jata hai. Complex ion ki aam shakal [M(L)ₓ]±ʸ hai, jahan M markazi metal ion, L ligand, x ligands ki tadaad (coordination number se tay) aur ±y complex ion ka kul charge hai.

blocks.caption: Table 18.3 Complex ion ka formula aur charge maloom karna
rows: Pehle metal (Co), phir ligand (NH₃) aur us ki tadaad (6) subscript mein, sab square brackets [ ] ke andar.
Pehle metal (Fe), phir ligand (CN) aur tadaad (6) subscript mein, brackets [ ] ke andar.
Pehle metal (Ni), phir ligand (CO) aur tadaad (4) subscript mein, brackets [ ] ke andar.
Metal ka charge + (ligands ki tadaad × ligand ka charge): musbat jama
Metal ka charge + (ligands ki tadaad × ligand ka charge): manfi jama
Metal ka charge + (ligands ki tadaad × ligand ka charge): sifar

blocks.title: Formula likhna
blocks.text: Pehle metal, phir ligand aur us ki tadaad subscript mein, sab square brackets ke andar; kul charge brackets ke bahar superscript mein. Charge = metal ka charge + (ligands ki tadaad × ligand ka charge).

blocks.prompt: Cu²⁺ aur chaar Cl⁻ ligands se banne wale complex ka formula aur charge batayein.

items: Aam shakal [M(L)ₓ]±ʸ; charge = metal ka charge + (x × ligand ka charge).
